editorAdapter.injectScript: url=>{const el=document.querySelector(".trix-content");const editor=el?.editor;if(!el||!editor)return false;try{const Trix=window.Trix;if(!Trix||!Trix.Attachment){console.error("Trix \u672A\u52A0\u8F7D\u6216\u7248\u672C\u4E0D\u517C\u5BB9");return false}const attachment=new Trix.Attachment({contentType:"image/png",url,filename:url.split("/").pop()||"image.png"});editor.insertAttachment(attachment);;return true}catch(err){console.error("Trix \u6CE8\u5165\u5931\u8D25:",err);return false}}
